schema.text: If the walking area is at road level, how is it separated from traffic?
schema.help: Bollards are short posts that stop vehicles from entering the walking area.

en.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: Bollards are short posts that stop vehicles from entering the walking area.
en.#If the walking area is at road level, h: If the walking area is at road level, how is it separated from traffic?

it.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: I dissuasori sono paletti bassi che impediscono ai veicoli di entrare nello spazio pedonale.
it.#If the walking area is at road level, h: Se lo spazio pedonale è a livello strada, come è separato dal traffico?

fr.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: Les potelets sont de petits poteaux qui empêchent les véhicules d’entrer dans l’espace piéton.
fr.#If the walking area is at road level, h: Si l’espace piéton est au niveau de la chaussée, comment est-il séparé de la circulation ?
fr.#Paint or road markings only: Peinture ou marquages au sol uniquement

de.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: Poller sind niedrige Pfosten, die Fahrzeuge daran hindern, in den Gehbereich zu fahren.
de.#If the walking area is at road level, h: Wie ist ein Gehbereich auf Fahrbahnniveau vom Verkehr getrennt?

tr.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: Babalar, araçların yürüme alanına girmesini önleyen kısa direklerdir.
tr.#If the walking area is at road level, h: Yürüme alanı yol seviyesindeyse trafikten nasıl ayrılıyor?

fa.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: استوبرها تیرک‌های کوتاهی هستند که مانع ورود خودروها به فضای پیاده می‌شوند.
fa.#If the walking area is at road level, h: اگر محدوده پیاده هم‌سطح جاده است، چگونه از ترافیک جدا می‌شود؟

hu.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: A terelőoszlopok alacsony oszlopok, amelyek megakadályozzák, hogy a járművek a gyalogos területre hajtsanak.
hu.#Planted strip, bushes, or planters: Növényzettel beültetett sáv, bokrok vagy növényládák
hu.#If the walking area is at road level, h: Ha a gyalogos terület az úttest szintjén van, hogyan választják el a forgalomtól?

ar.#Bollards are short posts that stop vehi: الأعمدة الحاجزة أعمدة قصيرة تمنع المركبات من دخول منطقة المشي.
ar.#Planted strip, bushes, or planters: شريط مزروع أو شجيرات أو أحواض نباتات
ar.#If the walking area is at road level, h: إذا كانت منطقة المشي على مستوى الطريق، فكيف تُفصل عن حركة المرور؟
